about: DEC-368 (housekeeping turn 3b) — the ONE ordered redaction rule set of every evidence writer: scripts/ci/redact.py (the lanes) and scripts/e2e-failure-report.ts `redact` (the E2E reporter) read this file; scripts/ci/redact.test.ts CF-REDACT-3 proves both give byte-identical output. A rule is a pattern rule { name, pattern, replacement, keep_env? } (a match equal to the keep_env variable's value stays) or an environment rule { name, env, replacement } (each named variable's value, when set, replaced as text). Patterns use only what Python's re (under re.ASCII) and JavaScript's RegExp read alike: no \s or \S, no (?P<…>) and no (?<name>…). A replacement names a group only as $1 … $9 and holds no other $.
